paragraphs.text: Ozox , also known as the Clattering King , is a skeleton noble from Innistrad .

Ozox has eternal unlife. His primary form is that of an amalgamation of various bones from different creatures, with his skull appearing similar to that of a crow, with a serpent's mandibles, and bovine horns. He is hairy and has spines all over his back.
When Ozox dies, he can reassemble himself from the skeleton known as Jumblebones .
